title: Matthew Stafford: We have a high ceiling, have to continue raising our floor

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Matthew Stafford: We have a high ceiling, have to continue raising our floor
sources.description: The Rams were among the favorites for Super Bowl LXI before they traded for Myles Garrett in June and acquiring the defensive player of the year has only pushed expectations for the coming season higher in Los Angeles.
